I can't answer that from this evidence. The tool checked 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03, which is the month *after* your date, not the two weeks before it. Anything from 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-03 was not evaluated.

For the period it did cover, NASA FIRMS found no thermal detections intersecting the property (ASSET-F05). All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day.

Even for that month, "not detected" doesn't prove that no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can be missed. The result also says nothing about burned area or the cause of any change.

To answer your question, the analysis would need to be re-run for 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-04.
